source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: Both passages exist; the detailed array zarr.json rule is stronger implementation guidance than the summary history wording. There is no evidence requiring an extra duplicate field in axes.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Pyramid name/type/downsampling metadata and appropriate-level policy
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: Metadata fields are SHOULD on the data, not compulsory reader UI fields. Selection heuristic is a product decision; every selected level must use its own geometry.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Unsupported codecs/chunks can be explained per item/level
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: A declared reader limit with named failure is valid; it is not evidence that those format inputs are forbidden.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: No prescribed threading/cache/performance/error mechanism; responsive cancellation outcome
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: The capture supplies format rules and no implementation timing/threading mechanism. The product itself requires responsive background reads/cancellation; no measured performance was established.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Malformed/unavailable input feedback taxonomy and no silent skips
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: The individual structural violations map to format rules. Crash avoidance/item-scoped explanation follows the plan. Exact message catalog and blanket every-event policy are product choices.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Axes composition/rank/order and optional dimensions
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: 2-5 rank, 2-3 spatial axes, optional time and channel/null/custom slot, order corresponding to the arrays, and SHOULD zyx are explicit. Names alone cannot identify semantic axes.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Absent dimensions versus length-one dimensions; supported navigation range
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: Both reports discuss axis-driven relevance, but neither explicitly distinguishes absent time/channel/z from present singleton axes or supplies an exact supported navigation range. This is a coverage omission, not a claim that such fixtures were executed.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: acquired but undeveloped

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Missing/null/custom type and unit tolerance
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: Recommended type/unit fields can be missing in contexts that remain conforming; however multiscales requires 2 or 3 entries of type:space. Blanket MUST-tolerate-any-missing/unknown type ignores that more specific constraint. The permitted null/custom extra axis is not proof that every spatial axis may be null.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: derived incorrectly / inherited or introduced unsupported assertion

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Position-only semantic classification or innermost-plane rule
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: This assertion family is referenced in broad seed verification but not explicitly recoverable as a standalone R011 assertion; excluded seed comparison remains unresolved. It is not charged as this R011 material failure.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: derived incorrectly / inherited or introduced unsupported assertion
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.phase2_seed_resolution: Exact seed U005 contains the position-inference/formula assertion. VRF-05 affirms U005 subject to listed clarifications, which do not identify these errors. This resolves seed correspondence only and does not edit phase1.

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Space/time units vocabulary; no channel-unit list
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: Only space/time lists are supplied. This does not prohibit meaningful channel/custom metadata or justify a universal assertion that channel scale can never matter.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: omero optional; channels/color/window field constraints
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: Required data fields, RGB six-hex format, and window min/max/start/end meaning match. Reader initialization details need interpretation beyond field presence.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: omero active/coefficient/family/inverted/label/rdefs/defaultT/defaultZ/model example siblings
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: The siblings occur in the example; required-field prose does not require them. Best-effort initialization is a sensible proposal, not proof of actual reader behavior.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: omero channel length matching occurs as example comment
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: The length comment exists; the required-field prose states no separate length MUST. Explicit overlap degradation is a proposed policy.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: No normative color/window semantics beyond field presence
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: RGB format and meanings of min/max/start/end are expressly stated. No gamma/family registry or explicit out-of-dtype-range rule is supplied, which is a narrower supported absence.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: derived incorrectly / inherited or introduced unsupported assertion

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Reader MUST apply particular initial contrast limits/colors; out-of-dtype-range/start>end automatically malformed
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: Presence/format constraints do not prove the proposed initial rendering policy or dtype-range rejection. Malformed color not satisfying six hex digits is supported; extending malformed status to unspecified window policies conflates specification silence and input invalidity.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: derived incorrectly / inherited or introduced unsupported assertion

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Absent omero leaves all rendering state with no embedded defaults
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: For intensity-channel defaults the source supplies no alternative omero block. A blanket all-rendering/no-embedded-display-defaults claim overlooks image-label colors and the reader SHOULD display them even if omero is absent.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: derived incorrectly / inherited or introduced unsupported assertion

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: General transforms sequential; identity/translation/scale and binary paths
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: Vocabulary, sequential list order and vector/path alternatives are explicit. Image transform lists have narrower types than this general vocabulary.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Dataset transform restrictions and fallback factors
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: Exactly one scale, at most one translation after scale, matching vector length, physical/time scale or relative fallback, and default 1 without downsampling are explicit.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Global transforms after dataset transforms; outer-after-inner composition
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: This rule applies to all supplied transform vectors, not just the time axis example. Correct function notation within each list is translation after scale.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Scale∘translate formula for a scale-before-translation list
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: This assertion family is referenced in broad seed verification but not explicitly recoverable as a standalone R011 assertion; excluded seed comparison remains unresolved. It is not charged as this R011 material failure.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: derived incorrectly / inherited or introduced unsupported assertion
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.phase2_seed_resolution: Exact seed U005 contains the position-inference/formula assertion. VRF-05 affirms U005 subject to listed clarifications, which do not identify these errors. This resolves seed correspondence only and does not edit phase1.

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Worked 5D example values and voxel arithmetic
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: Given scales [1,1,.5,.5,.5], [1,1,1,1,1], [1,1,2,2,2] and global [.1,1,1,1,1], the reported .1 ms/.5 micrometer level-zero voxel sizes are correct. This zero-translation example does not test offsets or reversed scale/translation order.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Worked calibration is a normative example
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: R011 expressly replaces normative-example terminology with informative example at report line 116 and verification /clarifications; the superseded seed wording is not retained as its current assertion.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: valid repair correctly retained

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Unknown units/calibration and channel-never-physical claim
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: Avoid inventing units; disclose unknown calibration. Unit absence alone does not change every provided scale into a proved relative factor. Channel index display is a sensible choice, but the universal never-meaningful-scale statement lacks source support.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: derived incorrectly / inherited or introduced unsupported assertion

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Origin lacks explicit anchoring; image-group-frame assumption
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: No explicit origin anchoring beyond coordinate spaces/offset is supplied. Declaring an image-frame assumption is valid; it is not a source guarantee.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Binary transform encoding gaps and vector-length counterevidence
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: Binary dtype/byte order/storage encoding are underspecified, but vector dimensionality and multiscale vector-length constraints are supplied. No dtype/shape rule whatsoever is too broad if it discards those constraints. Unsupported handling is a valid capability limit.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: No multi-axis global worked example; composition beyond time unresolved
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: Example absence is supported. General multi-axis composition is specified by the same sequential/global-after rules; missing example is not grounds to dismiss that rule as unresolved.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Concrete translation-sensitive calibration validation
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: Both preserve valid UNEXECUTED translation proposals, but neither gives a nonzero-offset worked expectation that could expose reversal/omission. No fixture or execution is required to credit a valid proposal; assigned full facet needs a concrete check.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: acquired but undeveloped

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Labels hierarchy, labels paths, arbitrary names and intermediate folders
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: Container declaration/list/path discovery and arbitrary names are supported. Intermediate groups may exist and MUST NOT carry metadata.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: All labels SHOULD be listed; unlisted scan policy
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: SHOULD listing permits reasoned exceptions. Additional scan/discovery policy is a product choice and cannot become format invalidity solely from being unlisted.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Labels multiscales, same source level count and eight integer dtypes
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: Exact dtype set and count requirement match. Integer type admission does not itself establish lossless host-number representation.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Label same-coordinate-system relation versus usually dimensions/transforms
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: Usually modifies equal dimensions/transformations, not the preceding same-coordinate-system relationship. Rephrasing this as usually same system weakens the association/registration premise.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: derived incorrectly / inherited or introduced unsupported assertion

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Same-or-one label dimensions and source force
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: Lowercase should remains recommended normative language; overview placement alone is not an exception. It is a SHOULD, not a geometric equality MUST. The report may propose explicit broadcast checks.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: derived incorrectly / inherited or introduced unsupported assertion

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Same-index levels, broadcast and own transforms with divergence warning
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: Reasonable rendering policy if source identity and physical mapping are resolved. Equal counts do not independently prove same-index geometry, and warning does not establish aligned overlay validity.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Label-versus-parent transform precedence wholly unspecified
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: There is no literal precedence sentence. A label must implement its own multiscales coordinate mapping, and that mapping cannot be silently replaced by the parent. Reports preserve an own-transform verification policy, but overstate uncertainty if they dismiss this requirement.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: image-label object and colors/version field force
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: image-label SHOULD be present; it SHOULD contain colors and version. Values are MUST array/string when supplied. Treating keys as unconditional MUST merely because image-label exists is stronger than source.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: derived incorrectly / inherited or introduced unsupported assertion

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Colors/properties key by integer label-value; rgba values/alpha
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: Color/property entries identify labels by value, with rgba four integers 0..255 and alpha opacity. Array order is not categorical identity.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Reader SHOULD use specified colors; fallback palette/legend/property UI
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: Color behavior is recommended, not universal mandatory styling. Fallback and property legend are product proposals; required legend/property UI is not necessary to the stated aligned-overlay acceptance.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Source.image relative path and ../../ default
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: Source is optional, image key is optional; supplied image must be a relative path to a Zarr image group. Source metadata identifies original image, not an arbitrary cosmetic string.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Resolve associated source before overlay; provenance-only restriction
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: R011 does not explicitly require relative-source identity resolution before overlay. R012 explicitly confines source.image to provenance and not overlay relocation, losing declared association when parent/default and explicit source differ. A conforming truthful unsupported result is acceptable; attaching by parent/shape without association validation is not established.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: acquired but undeveloped

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Sparse/large exact categorical IDs and resampling
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: Both preserve categorical/integer/label-value/nearest-neighbor ideas. Neither covers uint64/int64 IDs above exact binary64 range or declares an exact supported ID range, nor tests scrambled sparse IDs. This is an assigned coverage omission, not an assertion that arbitrary interpolation is specified in the source.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: acquired but undeveloped

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: No explicit interpolation/nearest/resampling algorithm
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: No named algorithm is supplied. Identity-preserving categorical rendering is a sound consequence; nearest-neighbor is one defensible product policy, not the uniquely required algorithm.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Label worked colors/properties/source example
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: Example values 0/1, rgba [0,0,128,128]/[0,128,0,128], alpha/color explanation, properties and relative source match. Example is informative.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Schema version-string vocabularies and accept-any-string policy
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: No independent field vocabulary enumeration is supplied. A string must identify the schema/spec version, not merely be any string. Displaying unknown values is a product policy; a universal never-gate rule is not source-derived.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.assertion: Implementation pointer and lack of actual reader performance/interop evidence
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: The pointer section contains no implementation requirements or measured interop/performance results. Holding real tool interoperability unresolved is correct and is not an incompatibility finding. The source does contain an Implementations heading.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.evidence: complete S003:1-896; report and negative-check limits
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: Scoping a search does not make a missed paraphrase/source restriction absent. Many narrow absence conclusions are corroborated by this independent full read; negative clauses with actual counterevidence remain false despite scope disclaimers.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: No explicit scanning prohibition is supplied; labeling it inference is accurate. Even inferred metadata authority does not forbid auxiliary scanning if the final identity/order remains validated.
source_supported_acquisition_inventory.preservation_category: source-supported core retained with stated qualifications

Mandatory property legends/full pyramid metadata UI/particular fallback rendering overreach additional-capability review. Background responsiveness is required by the plan, not measured format implementation evidence.

source_supported_acquisition_inventory.reason: All are current proposals, not test execution. Missing filesets/execution logs do not make the proposals false. Their seed-relative sameness/verbatim preservation cannot be established without excluded seed/history.

trajectories.title: Versioned metadata admission
trajectories.reason: Zarr v3, attributes.ome, explicit 0.5 product boundary and hierarchy consistency survive both finals; no supported version-admission fact is deleted.

trajectories.title: Declared arrays/axis identity and pyramid order
trajectories.reason: Group-relative declared paths, largest/highest-resolution first, arbitrary names, rank/order and dimension_names survive. No fixed numbered-folder or factor-of-two policy is introduced.

trajectories.title: Absent versus singleton dimensions
trajectories.reason: Optional-axis and rank premises are present, but neither seed nor any completed verifier version develops absent-vs-present-length-one control identity. This is not a draft-to-final loss.

trajectories.title: Overbroad untyped tolerance and position inference
trajectories.reason: The seed has both type:space composition requirements and missing-type/position inference. Both verifiers affirm this mixture without resolving the specific 2/3-space constraint. The error predates these verifier drafts.

trajectories.title: Per-level scale/translation and global-after-dataset rule
trajectories.reason: Correct source rule and sample scale arithmetic are present in seed and both finals. Semantic preservation of this rule does not validate the contradictory notation also in seed/R012.

trajectories.title: Within-list composition notation
trajectories.reason: The seed already writes global(scale∘translate) ∘ perLevel(scale∘translate). R012 carries it unchanged into V002 and every later report. R011 omits the formula but affirms U005 composition/arithmetic, leaving the unsupported seed notation unflagged. It is not a new R012 invention or a proved valid formula lost from R011.

trajectories.title: Concrete nonzero-translation expected result
trajectories.reason: Translation order and valid UNEXECUTED V5 proposals are acquired. No seed or available completed report develops a nonzero-offset worked expectation capable of catching reversal/offset omission. Missing execution fixtures do not invalidate the proposals.

trajectories.title: Multi-axis composition treated as unresolved because no worked example
trajectories.reason: Absence of another worked example is true; the generic composition rule is still specified. R012 N-25 limit says multi-axis behavior beyond time unresolved; R011 unresolved-area list also includes multi-axis composition. This additional uncertainty weakens a supported general rule rather than documenting a measured implementation gap.

trajectories.title: Units and truthful unknown calibration
trajectories.reason: Both retain unknown/no-unit disclosure and no invented units. Unit absence alone proving relative rather than physical scale and channel-never-meaningful scaling remain overstatements inherited from seed, not new supported findings.

trajectories.title: Label discovery/count/integer categorical premises
trajectories.reason: Intermediate folders, declared label paths, multiscales, equal level count, integer categorical values and label-value identity survive semantically. R011 summarizes rather than rendering all exact dtype tokens.

trajectories.title: 64-bit exact categorical identity
trajectories.reason: The seed names uint64/int64 and labels by integer value. R012 retains all eight dtype spellings; R011 final report contains none of those spellings. Neither develops binary64 precision avoidance/exact supported range or sparse/scrambled ID checks. The source premise is acquired; its required identity implications remain undeveloped.

trajectories.title: Label source association restricted to provenance
trajectories.reason: The seed already says follow source.image only to annotate provenance, not relocate overlay. R012 retains that rule; R011 summarizes provenance rules under SUPPORTED without identifying the association defect. No correct source-resolution requirement is observed earlier and then lost.

trajectories.title: Label coordinate-system and lower-case should force
trajectories.reason: Seed quotes the same-coordinate-system relationship but doubts force because overview/usually. R012 repeats this and N-26; R011 compresses it to usually same system, moving the qualifier from shapes/transforms to the coordinate-system relation. Source lower-case should is normative recommended force, not force-free overview prose.

trajectories.title: image-label colors/version SHOULD upgraded to key-presence MUST
trajectories.reason: Seed explicitly makes version string MUST be present; both finals affirm it. This is inherited force error, not valid optional-field content correctly rejected.

trajectories.title: Recommended label palette and categorical resampling policy
trajectories.reason: Reader SHOULD specified colors, value-keyed lookup, rgba/alpha, optional properties/source and categorical/noninterpolating policy survive. Nearest-neighbor is correctly presented as a product choice; mandatory legends/property presentation remains an unsupported elevation.

trajectories.title: No Zarr-feature disallowance despite acquired integer-only labels
trajectories.reason: The seed contains both the no-disallowance conclusion and integer-only label restriction. Both verifiers preserve both without resolving the inconsistency; R012 N-01 scopes searches but still falsely confirms the negative. This is acquired counterevidence left unused, not inaccessible evidence.

trajectories.title: No color/window semantics beyond presence
trajectories.reason: Seed includes six-hex RGB and then denies semantics beyond presence. Both affirm the denial despite available meanings/format constraints; R012 N-15 also acknowledges RGB then confirms the broad absence. No gamma/registry rule is the narrower supported absence.

trajectories.title: Absent omero implies no embedded display defaults universally
trajectories.reason: Intensity defaults are a legitimate product question. The blanket assertion ignores independently supplied image-label colors. R012 adds N-16 scoped confirmation; neither repairs the overbreadth.

trajectories.title: Actual implementations unavailable versus incompatibility
trajectories.reason: The source Tools pointer and absence of measured reader behavior are preserved. Unopened implementation evidence is outside the admitted source set, not a supported fact removed by the verifier.

trajectories.title: No tool names or versions in source
trajectories.reason: R012 negative-checks counterevidence claims no tool names/versions although its own acquisition keyword version inventory records skimage 0.16.1 at L379 and seed U004 mentions skimage. bioformats2raw is also ubiquitous. This new negative is directly counterevidenced within acquired content.

trajectories.title: Read-only, local scope and item-scoped truthful unsupported behavior
trajectories.reason: Both keep source-unchanged/session-local, explain undisplayable data, and separate product boundary from format nonconformance. No unsupported input is proved malformed merely because a fileset was not supplied.

trajectories.title: Derived opening/listing rules versus literal source MUST
trajectories.reason: R011 expressly classifies plate-first synthesis and labels exclusion as derivations. Both soften directory-scan nonconformance to inference. This is valid provenance/force correction and not false rejection of metadata authority; auxiliary scanning still is not explicitly prohibited.

trajectories.title: Informative example terminology
trajectories.reason: R011 corrects normative example to informative in V001 report and V003 verification. R012 preserves normative example in V002..V008. The source numbers are valid in both; correcting force does not discard arithmetic.

trajectories.title: Editorial exact wording
trajectories.reason: R012 corrects by the by the to defined by / by the, already in V001 report and later negative record. R011 calls the seeded wrong wording verified. The source behavior is unchanged; this is an exact-text repair only.

trajectories.title: All nine UNEXECUTED proposal families
trajectories.reason: Both preserve proposal coverage and UNEXECUTED qualification. R011 PV reindexing and R012 glyph/prose normalization mean neither claim should be read as exact seed-byte reproduction. No actual execution result is acquired.

trajectories.title: Useful source counterevidence versus nominal full verification
trajectories.reason: No unsupported seed unit is rejected as a unit; all twelve are positively dispositioned. Several useful corrections occur, but integer restriction, explicit color/window meanings, association and precise optionality fail to constrain those approvals. This is missed counterevidence/false approval, not an observed wholesale false dismissal of a supported seed unit.
